name: DLV - conversion_priority
notes: primary for line_survey_complete and phone_click; secondary for line_click

name: DLV - attribution_latest_srt_keyword
notes: Diagnostics only; do not render as copy

name: DLV - lead_persona
notes: homeowner, procurement, or contractor from the mandatory LINE survey; also mapped to a GA4 User Property

name: DLV - value
notes: Conversion value on line_survey_complete: 0 or 1, matches lead_quality_score

name: CE - line_click
notes: Fires on website line_click dataLayer event; analytics only, not for bidding

name: CE - line_survey_start
notes: Fires when the mandatory persona survey modal opens for a paid session

name: CE - line_survey_complete
notes: Fires when the persona survey is answered, just before LINE opens

name: CE - phone_click
notes: Fires on website phone_click dataLayer event

name: GA4 Event - line_click
configuration: event_name=line_click; include all P0 DLV parameters
notes: Analytics only; do not import/include in Google Ads bidding. Denominator for survey completion rate.

name: GA4 Event - line_survey_start
configuration: event_name=line_survey_start; include page, CTA, and attribution DLV parameters

name: GA4 Event - line_survey_complete
configuration: event_name=line_survey_complete; include all P0 DLV parameters including lead_persona, lead_quality_score, value; map lead_persona to GA4 User Property
notes: Primary lead event; value-based. Verify in DebugView before marking key event. Only import into Google Ads bidding once Phase 2 threshold (30+ conv/month sustained) is reached -- Phase 1 uses Maximize Clicks.

name: GA4 Event - phone_click
configuration: event_name=phone_click; include all P0 DLV parameters
notes: Primary lead event; verify in DebugView before marking key event

name: GA4 Event - contact_click
configuration: event_name=contact_click; include page and CTA parameters only
notes: Analytics only; do not import/include in Google Ads bidding

name: Google tag / GA4 base tag
configuration: Measurement ID from GA4 web stream
notes: Confirm no duplicate page_view before publishing
